# X

Generated from [tokens.json](tokens.json) and [README.md](README.md) by the design-systems catalog tool. Do not edit this file: change the tokens through the package's builders, then run `make design-md` at the repository root.

It follows the DESIGN.md spec, version alpha. That format has no themes, no per-value provenance and only px, em and rem units, so this file holds the `light` theme alone with every alias resolved. [tokens.json](tokens.json) is the source of truth: it records where each value was read, holds the `dark` theme, and keeps the 3 tokens from these groups that DESIGN.md cannot hold (gradients, shadows, percentages, durations and other non-colour or non-px values).

## Overview

Good for: Signed-out social login chrome on black: a 64px Chirp headline, light 9999px pills, a 6px sky-bordered field, and a white legal surface with a 144px headline. Brand link blue is #1d9bf0..

Captured 2026-11-19, signed out (login chrome, a missing-route shell, terms, privacy and about.x.com were read; no email, phone or password was typed; Continue, Google, Apple, Sign In and Log in were not pressed; no account was created and nothing was posted). Themes: dark, light.

Public signed-out surfaces of X (x.com, formerly Twitter), measured on 19 November 2026. The login chrome and a missing-route shell were read in a signed-out T3 preview tab. The terms and privacy pages were also screenshotted in headless Chromium after they had already loaded without a challenge. No account was created, no email or phone was typed, and nothing was posted.

Themes seen: dark on x.com and about.x.com, light on the legal pages. Widths: the preview tab was 1169 by 731 at device pixel ratio 2. The legal screenshots are 1440 by 900 and 390 by 844, also at ratio 2.

## Typography

### Fonts (from README.md)

TwitterChirp is the product face on x.com, weights 300, 400 and 500, served from abs.twimg.com. Helvetica Neue LT is the legal-page face. xVF and xVFDisplay are the about.x.com faces, a variable 200 to 800 woff2. All three are proprietary and are not shipped. Tokens name them, then fall back to the system sans.

## Do's and Don'ts

- Do take values from [tokens.json](tokens.json) when you need another theme, a value's source, or a token this file leaves out.
- Do read [README.md](README.md) before relying on a value; it says what is known to be wrong.
- Don't read colours off the screenshots; they are 256-colour PNGs.
- Don't copy the product's logo, icons, illustrations or brand colours into something that ships. Borrow structure and proportions.
- Don't edit this file; it is regenerated from the tokens.

### What to distrust (from README.md)

The login field border was already #0ea5e9 on load. That is the painted state, not a hover measurement. The Continue control is a div with a stone label. It was not pressed, so its filled state is a gap.

The Google button is Google Identity Services chrome (Google Sans, 20px radius). It is recorded as third-party and is not an X token.

The date band colour is a screenshot sample, rgb(20, 23, 26), because the text node itself is transparent. The legal body computed at 15.96px and is stored as 16px. The QR card radius computed at 21.6px and is stored as 22px. The Show more radius computed at 14.4px and is stored as 14px.

about.x.com at 1169px hides the desktop header, including Sign In. Those values are declared and zero-size. The painted header is the mobile About menu.

TwitterChirp, Helvetica Neue LT and xVF are not in this package. The style guide uses the system sans.

### Do and don't (from README.md)

- **Use the white pill on black for the primary action.** The painted Continue with phone control is #f8fafc on #000000, fully rounded. See [raw/readings.json](raw/readings.json).
- **Keep the legal pages light and huge.** The terms headline is 144px Helvetica Neue LT at 1440, black on white. See [screenshots/tos-light-1440.png](screenshots/tos-light-1440.png).
- **Use #1d9bf0 for the brand link.** Show more and `--color-brand` both resolve to it. See [raw/readings.json](raw/readings.json).
- **Do not invent a hover or an error colour.** Neither was on the page.
- **Do not ship TwitterChirp.** Name it, then fall back.
